name: Latte Doom
description: A DOOM source port whose renderer is the Minecraft world. The real id Tech 1 engine (via Mocha Doom) runs inside Minecraft's JVM and owns ALL simulation — collision, monsters, specials, RNG, 35Hz tics — while the level is rendered as walkable 3D geometry around you. Lineage: Chocolate Doom -> Mocha Doom -> Cocoa Doom -> Latte Doom.
